subject: general
question: What is the shape of the eyeball?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spherical**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The shape of the eyeball is **spherical**.
 
• This spherical shape allows the eye to have a wide range of motion and helps in the proper focusing of light onto the retina.
 
• The spherical structure is crucial for maintaining the eye's internal pressure and overall health.
 
• Any significant deviation from this shape can lead to vision problems, such as astigmatism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The human eye is approximately 24 millimeters in diameter.
 
• The eye consists of several important parts, including the cornea, lens, retina, and optic nerve, all of which contribute to vision.
 
• Regular eye check-ups are essential for maintaining ocular health and detecting any changes in the shape or condition of the eyeball.
 
• Conditions like myopia (nearsightedness) and hyperopia (farsightedness) are related to the shape of the eyeball.
